messages.subject: simsem error "replication not convergent"
parts:
hi there, 

I was trying to replicat a code from a book of Kline. It seemed fairly simple but I get the error: Fehler in clean(object, improper = improper) :
All replications in the result object are not convergent. Thus, the result object cannot be used.

this is the code:

# data generation model

datMod<-"
# regression with known corr = 0.2
y~0.2*TRT
# error variance
y~~0.96*y"

datMod

# analysis model
estMod <- "
# regression
y~TRT"

# load simsem
library(simsem)

# call sim to do the simulation

simOut <- sim(nrep=10, generate=datMod, model=estMod, n=198,
           lavaanfun="sem",seed=123, silent=TRUE)

summaryParam(simOut)

for any hint I would be thankful!

Michael.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: simsem error "replication not convergent"
parts: I was trying to replicat a code from a book of Kline. It seemed fairly simple but I get the error:
That's not an error message, just a message from summaryParam() telling you none of the replications converged.  To find out why, you can run sim() without telling it to be silent:

simOut <- sim(nrep=10, generate=datMod, model=estMod, n=198,
           lavaanfun="sem",seed=123, silent=TRUE)
> simOut <- sim(nrep=10, generate=datMod, model=estMod, n=198,

+               lavaanfun="sem",seed=123, silent=FALSE)
Progress: 1 / 1
Error : lavaan->lav_lavaan_step02_options():  
   unknown argument: 'nrep'
 

R is case-sensitive.  You need a capital R in the nRep= argument.
